content.english: People of faith, you should walk in [accordance with] God’s Torah,
Then you will merit to see Adonai’s sweetness.

content.hebrew: שְׂאוּ יְדֵיכֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ, וְשֵׁם יוי בָּרְכוּ.
content.transliteration: Se’u yedekhem ḳodesh, veshem Adonai barekhu.
content.english: Lift up your hands in holiness, and render blessing unto Adonai’s name.

content.hebrew: קהל: אֲנִי יוי אֱלֹהֵיכֶם; בְּחֻקֹּתַי לֵֽכוּ.  (אין במקרא)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ani Adonai elohekhem; beḥuḳḳotai lekhu.
content.english: Cong. I am Adonai your God; walk in My ways.   (Not in Scripture)

content.hebrew: הִנֵּה מָה רַב טוּבוֹ אֲשֶׁר צָפַן
content.transliteration: Hinnē mah rav tuvo asher tsafan
content.english: See, how great is His goodness, which he has hidden away
For those who observe His covenant and purify their body.
[But] those who spurn His words will [experience] devastation and famine,
Cong. And He turns the wheel over them.    (Prov. 20:26)
Clean your heart, and purify your hands,
Observe the law that is inscribed on the two tablets.

content.hebrew: וְאִם כֹּה תַעֲשׂוּ, טוּבְכֶם יִהְיֶה כִפְלָֽיִם –
content.transliteration: Ve’im ko ta‘asu, tuvekhem yihyē khiflayim –
content.english: And if you do so, your good [fortune] will be double—

content.hebrew: קהל: כֹּל מִשְׁעַן לֶֽחֶם וְכֹל מִשְׁעַן מָֽיִם.  (משלי כ:כו)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: kol mish‘an leḥem vekhol mish‘an mayim.
content.english: Cong. [You will have] every staff of bread, and every staff of water. (Isa. 3:1)
Choose for yourselves the path of uprightness;
Have your thoughts ascend the ladder of faith;
Turn your faces to the beauty of holiness—

content.hebrew: קהל: וְלֹא תִגְעַל נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶם.   (ויקרא כו:יא)
content.english: Cong. And My soul will not despise you.    (Lev. 26:11)
Take refuge in His shade, children of the mighty!
content.comments: Children of the mighty. Descendants of the patriarchs.

content.hebrew: פְּדוּת קָרְבָה, וּבָאָה שַׁבָּת וְיוֹבֵל לְנֶאֱמָנִים.
content.transliteration: Pedut ḳarevah, uva’a shabbat veyovel lene’emanim.
content.english: Redemption is near, and the Sabbath and Jubilee are coming for the faithful.

content.hebrew: יֵֽצֶר סָמוּךְ אֶצֹּר, וְאֶקְרָא דְרוֹר לַבָּנִים,
content.transliteration: Yetser samukh ets’tsor, ve’eḳra deror labbanim,
content.english: I will soon besiege the [evil] inclination, and proclaim liberty for [My] children,

content.hebrew: קהל: וְזָכַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּרִית רִאשׁוֹנִים.  (ויקרא כו:מה)
content.english: Cong. And I will remember for them [My] covenant with the ancients.  (Lev. 26:45)
Children of my beloved ones, gird yourself with strength, to renew [yourselves],

content.hebrew: עֶֽרֶךְ נַפְשְׁךָ כְּעֶֽרֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי רוּם לְקַדֵּשׁ,
content.transliteration: Erekh nafshekha ke‘erekh malakhē rum leḳaddesh,
content.english: Your life is as valuable as the angels on high, [in its ability] to sanctify,
To be similar to the holy creatures [of heaven],

content.hebrew: קהל: וְכָל־עֶרְכְּךָ יִהְיֶה בְּשֶֽׁקֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ.  (ויקרא כז:כה)
content.english: Cong. And all your value will be in the holy sheqel.  (Lev. 27:25)
I have called you, justly, the scion of My faithful ones,
I have compared you to the stars of My heaven.
On your behalf, I will destroy every [other] nation before Me,

content.hebrew: קהל: עַתָּה אָקוּם יֹאמַר יוי.   (ישעיה לג:י)
content.english: Cong. Now I shall arise, says Adonai.    (Isa. 33:10)

content.hebrew: חזן: עַתָּ֥ה אָק֖וּם יֹאמַ֣ר יו֑י עַתָּה֙ אֵֽרוֹמָ֔ם עַתָּ֖ה אֶנָּשֵֽׂא:
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: ‘atta aḳum yomar Adonai ‘atta eromam ‘atta ennasseh:
content.english: Cantor. Now I shall arise, says Adonai; now I shall be elevated, now I shall be lofty. (Isa. 33:10)

content.hebrew: וַיִּגְבַּ֛הּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְהָאֵ֙ל הַקָּד֔וֹשׁ נִקְדָּ֖שׁ בִּצְדָקָֽה:
content.transliteration: Vayiḡbah Adonai tseva’ot bammishpat veha’el haḳḳadosh niḳdash bitsdaḳah:
content.english: And Adonai Ẓeva’oth is towering high in justice; and the holy God is sanctified in righteousness. (Isa. 5:16)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “the Lord of Hosts.”

content.hebrew: קהל: קָד֖וֹשׁ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יו֣י צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ:
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ḳadosh, ḳadosh ḳadosh Adonai tseva’ot melo khol ha’arets kevodo:
content.english: Cong. Holy, holy, holy is Adonai Ẓeva’oth; the entire world is full of His Glory. (Isa. 6:3)
